pages.text: From the heretical members of the Nether cult, you learned about the higher-ranking cultists among them. Known as loyal followers and students of a being called 'the Apostle', these Acolytes hold a high status within the cult. They are capable of wielding various Nether spells, and even some of the Apostle's own power, to devastate those they deem heretics.
Because of their close ties to the Apostle, they too have become undead.
If you shatter an Obsidian Monolith belonging to the cult, an enraged Acolyte may appear and rain down 'Sacred Fire' upon you, judging you as a heretic.
